verdict.rationale: Better Auth is an auth framework, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair axis. Its docs say it hosts a remote MCP server that MCP clients such as Cursor, Codex and Claude Code can connect to. However, that server only exposes documentation search, examples and setup help, and the evidence includes no connection or configuration walkthrough. The MCP plugin is a separate building block for integrators to make their own apps OAuth servers for MCP clients, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: MCP tools beyond documentation help, documented connection/configuration steps for clients, independent or hands-on corroboration of the hosted server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Better Auth hosts a remote MCP server that exposes documentation search, examples, and setup help to any MCP-capable client (Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, Open Code, and others).
